subject: mcc-health-promotion
title: Developmental screening: surveillance, positive screens and avoiding misdiagnosis

steps.tx: **Developmental surveillance** is a continuous process at every well-child visit, combining parental concern, clinical observation and milestone review. It is not a one-off test. Normal growth does not exclude a developmental problem, so growth alone must never end the discussion.
steps.say: Developmental surveillance is a continuous process at every well-child visit. It combines parental concern, clinical observation and milestone review, and it is not a one-off test. Normal growth does not exclude a developmental problem, so growth alone must never end the discussion.

steps.tx: **Standardised validated screening tools** give reproducible results across clinicians and detect delay more reliably than unstructured impression. Screening identifies risk; it does not make a diagnosis. A positive screen is therefore followed by formal diagnostic assessment, never by treatment or reassurance alone.
steps.say: Standardised validated screening tools give reproducible results across clinicians and detect delay more reliably than unstructured impression. steps.tx: **Autism screening** in toddlers uses a structured questionnaire completed by parents or carers. A high-risk result should lead to prompt **referral for formal diagnostic assessment**, without waiting. Medication such as risperidone does not treat the core social and communication difficulties, and brain imaging is not a routine first investigation when the birth history is normal.

steps.tx: **Hypothyroidism** can blunt development, so it belongs in any screen for delayed milestones. Look for constipation, dry skin, **hypotonia** and a large tongue. A raised **TSH** with low free thyroxine points to primary disease. Start **levothyroxine** promptly, since thyroid hormone drives early brain growth and myelination.

steps.tx: **Language and cultural difference** can mimic disorder. A child who speaks another language at home may score low on English tests while hearing, vision and social skills are normal. Assessment should use a **qualified interpreter** and culturally appropriate tools, so that true language and cognitive ability are measured rather than exposure to English.

steps.tx: **Iron deficiency** can present with language delay, pallor and microcytosis. Excess cow's milk displaces iron-rich foods and can cause occult gastrointestinal blood loss. Treat the **iron deficiency anaemia** with oral iron, reduce milk intake, and refer separately for speech and developmental assessment, since both problems need action.

steps.tx: **Summary for exams**: screen with a validated tool, act on a positive result with formal diagnostic assessment, check thyroid and iron status when milestones lag, and use an interpreter when language is not English. Never treat a screen as a diagnosis.
